messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — elevated 5xx rate detected for inference-runtime (us-west-2a). Error class: SIGSEGV / OOM observed on model-runner pods. Auto-escalation to on-call.

alice_sre: I'm on it. Pulling up dashboards now. Can someone confirm customer impact surface?

alice_sre: metrics — 5xx rate spike started at 15:03 UTC, error rate peaked ~18% for /v1/generate. Latency tail increased, many timeouts > 25s.

ben_runtime: seeing repeated segfaults in model-runner logs right when big batches hit. grabbing pod logs.

ben_runtime: `kubectl -n inference logs model-runner-5f7b88 -c runner --since=10m`
```
[2026-03-15T15:04:12Z] model-runner[1]: inference_worker: segfault (code 11) at 0x7fffb3aef000
[2026-03-15T15:04:12Z] model-runner[1]: stack: libtorch::... call_site+0x1b
[2026-03-15T15:04:12Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 23456 (model-runner) total-vm: 12000000kB, anon-rss: 9800000kB
```

carla_support: We have a few customer tickets about 502s in the past 15m, CSPs reporting increased timeouts. Not wide spread but high severity for heavy-usage accounts.

dave_infra: nodes in us-west-2a show GPU memory pressure and OOM kills around the same timestamps. Looks like large sequences triggering KV cache growth + concurrent sessions.

alice_sre: ok, immediate action plan: 1) divert traffic from us-west-2a to healthy regions if possible 2) scale up dedicated pool temporarily 3) roll traffic to fallback smaller model variant 4) limit concurrency on runners to avoid OOM cascade.

ops-bot: Runbook step triggered: incident/#assign oncall -> alice_sre

alice_sre: (added :eyes: reaction) Ben, can you patch the deployment to set MAX_CONCURRENCY=1 for the affected model group? That should reduce per-pod memory spike.

ben_runtime: applying patch now. `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/model-runner MAX_CONCURRENCY=1 --record`
ben_runtime: restarting affected pods with `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-runner` — rolling restart started.

ben_runtime: also toggled KVCACHE_PREFIX_EVICT_PERCENT=30 to force more aggressive eviction of KV cache.

alice_sre: routing change in progress — updating smart-router policy to shift 60% of traffic to us-west-2b and fallback models.

elena_prod: heads up — I notified account ops for high-usage customers and opened a high-priority support thread for impacted customers.

dave_infra: started adding 2 more GPU nodes to the pool (scale from 6 -> 8). Provisioning ETA ~4m. Launching new nodes with larger host memory to reduce OOM risk.

ben_runtime: after restart, new pods come up healthy, logs show fewer OOMs. Early indicators: 5xx rate dropping to 4%.

carla_support: customers reporting improvement, some still seeing intermittent 502s. Keeping support page updated.

alice_sre: collecting heap traces and the coredump from one of the crashed pods. Will upload to shared bucket.

ben_runtime: coredump backtrace snippet:
```
#0  0x00007fffb3aef000 in ?? ()
#1  0x000055aaee2b1234 in attention_forward at attention.cpp:482
#2  0x000055aaee2b5678 in forward_chunk at model.cpp:219
#3  0x000055aaee2c0000 in worker_loop at runner.cc:114
```

alice_sre: hypothesis: a large batch + long context triggered quantized attention kernel path which has a regression on the current build leading to memory corruption and eventual OOM. Plan: revert that kernel patch in staging first then can rollback in prod if confirmed.

ben_runtime: creating a hotfix build without the new attention kernel. CI build started. If pass, we'll canary to one node.

alice_sre: in parallel: enable safety fallback to use FP16 kernel path by setting ENV ENABLE_KERNEL_FALLBACK=true for model-runner. This is safer if the quantized kernel is buggy.

ben_runtime: applied fallback env var and restarted a canary pod. Canary looks stable for 5m with low memory footprint.

incident-bot: Incident status — mitigation in progress. Current 5xx rate: 3.2% (down from 18%). Routing and concurrency limits applied. Actions: canary FP16 fallback, scale up nodes. Next update in 10m.

dave_infra: GPU nodes up and joined cluster. Autoscaler logs show no further evictions.

carla_support: Sending proactive update email to affected customers; noted mitigation steps and ETA for full recovery ~30m.

alice_sre: preparing handoff: if rate stays <1% and canary stable, we can remove emergency routing in 30m and reenable normal routing. Postmortem to cover root cause: kernel regression on quantized attention + insufficient KV cache caps under high concurrency.

elena_prod: logging customer impact: 12 accounts had >5% errors, two enterprise customers experienced request-level failures for ~6m. We'll coordinate credits/SLAs after postmortem.

ben_runtime: CI hotfix passed unit tests. Will deploy hotfix with rollback window. Deploying to canary group now.

ben_runtime: canary hotfix rollout successful — canary pod stable. Starting gradual rollout across us-west-2.

alice_sre: monitoring — error rate continues to decline to ~0.6%. Latencies normalized. Good progress.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated. Remaining action items: collect coredumps, finalize hotfix rollout, full postmortem, update regression tests to cover large-batch quantized attention, add KV cache hard cap.

alice_sre: handing off to dave_infra for overnight monitoring and postmortem ownership. dave, please pick up and file P0 postmortem with timeline + ops notes.

dave_infra: taking handoff. I'll open the postmortem and assign follow-ups. Thanks all for the quick triage.

carla_support: I'll follow up with customers and attach timeline once postmortem published.

alice_sre: end of incident thread. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
